# Composting at home

A third of what a household throws away could become soil instead of landfill.

## Greens and browns

Mix wet scraps, like peels and coffee grounds, with dry matter, like leaves and cardboard, about one to two. Too wet smells; too dry does nothing.

## Turning

Stir the pile every week to let air in. In two or three months the bottom is dark and smells of forest floor.
